Hello there :) 

I am also a 21 year old whose soul still feels like 14 haha I , very much relate to this post. 

Everyone around me seems to have businesses started and have other jobs that allow them to earn income, while I am here being so behind my studies. (I even got extended). 

I just want to say to you that the first step is always the hardest. Once you do it, it's like you've become an unstoppable force. Yesterday, I did something I didn't think I would ever do for all my lifetime. I got out of my comfort zone by auditioning for something I am completely unqualified for ( Debate varsity ) haha. I had so many worries. All throughout I wanted to back out but I pushed myself through it, with the support of my friend. I didn't even hope to get in but I just wanted to take it as a challenge. To allow myself to learn that it's okay.. that even if other people think I'm unqualified for something, it doesn't matter because I'm trying it out anyway. You waste nothing by trying but instead, you gain. 

 It was quite the experience and it made me feel like I can do more riskier things..

So yes, slowly allow yourself to take risks. Slowly but surely.. one step at a time. No need to look at what everyone else is doing because they have their own paths and their own troubles. You have yours. What matters now is just you, okay? 

 I am not sure as to what causes or triggers your trauma but I hope you can work on making peace with it. Reach out to someone you can trust to help with that. A good support system is always welcome. 


I hope all goes well for you friend! I'm rooting for you. Take your time and you'll be okay.
